description: This file defines the LoyaltyProgram class and functions related to managing loyalty points, retrieving loyalty program details, and validating loyalty point redemption within an ERP system.

classes.name: LoyaltyProgram
classes.description: Represents a loyalty program, inheriting from Document, with no additional attributes or methods defined.

methods.name: get_loyalty_details
methods.description: Retrieves total loyalty points and total spent for a customer in a specific loyalty program, optionally filtered by expiry date and company.

methods.name: get_loyalty_program_details_with_points
methods.description: Fetches detailed loyalty program info along with the customer's loyalty points, including tier level based on total spent.

methods.name: get_loyalty_program_details
methods.description: Gets loyalty program details for a customer, including program info and default company if not specified.

methods.name: get_redeemption_factor
methods.description: Returns the conversion factor for redeeming loyalty points in a specified loyalty program.

methods.name: validate_loyalty_points
methods.description: Validates and processes the redemption of loyalty points against a reference document, ensuring sufficient points and correct value.
